title: Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza, medics say, amid new ceasefire push
summary_or_snippet: Reuters reported that Gaza health officials said Israeli strikes killed four Palestinians, while Hamas representatives met mediators in Cairo about efforts to advance a fragile ceasefire.

title: Israeli maps outline expanded zone of military control in Gaza
summary_or_snippet: Reuters reported that maps issued by Israel marked expanded restricted areas in Gaza, with aid sources saying the maps had been shared with aid groups in March.

title: UN says Israel blocks durable shelter materials from entering Gaza
summary_or_snippet: Anadolu Agency reported UN spokesman Stephane Dujarric saying aid agencies could bring basic shelter supplies into Gaza but not materials needed for durable shelter.
